component.name: Moonglow Viewer
component.summary: View, decompile and edit Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition models

description.p: Moonglow Viewer opens every visual file Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition uses (models, walkmeshes, textures, materials, blueprints) and lights them as the game does, with emitters and visual effects running. It decompiles and compiles models in one click, edits a model's ASCII source with the view following every edit, and renders stills, turntables and galleries from the command line.
Moonglow Viewer reads the game's data from your installation; most of it needs a copy of Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition.
Moonglow Toolset 1.16.1's renderer; PLT colors picked from their palettes, in the window and on the command line; labels and headings as the toolset's.
Arrow keys step through the lists and W, A, S, D move the camera; the grid hides behind models; colored body parts take their skin and clothing colors.
A click opens from the resource list; one-frame animations show as a pose.
